recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical ensemble portrait set within a brightly lit, modern barbershop. The composition features a central lead figure flanked by a diverse group of characters, some seated in vintage barber chairs and others standing, all positioned over a black-and-white checkered floor with a high-contrast title treatment at the top center.
coreVisualRelationships: Central lead figure as the primary vertical axis
Symmetrical distribution of supporting cast members
Checkerboard floor providing a receding perspective grid
High-key interior lighting contrasting with saturated red and black wardrobe
Title block anchored to the top center with a thematic icon
coreInvariants: Black and white checkered floor pattern
Vintage leather and chrome barber chairs
Bright, airy interior with large windows in the background
Red as the primary accent color in clothing and branding

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central figure in the foreground; two seated figures at mid-ground left and right; remaining cast standing in a tiered arc behind them.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central standing figure in a black shirt, acting as the fulcrum of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top title, drops to the central figure's face, then radiates outward to the seated figures and the surrounding ensemble.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with figures to emphasize a community atmosphere.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral whites and grays from the shop interior and floor.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark blues in denim and shirts.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red used in shirts, leggings, and the primary title text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (bright) background with high saturation (vivid) foreground elements to create depth.

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses a bold, high-contrast serif with sharp terminals
Secondary text uses a clean, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif
Integration of a barber pole icon into the initial letter
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'B' in the main title is integrated with a vertical barber pole graphic
The 'S' in the main title has an elongated tail
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the brand name paired with a heavy, wide sans-serif for the subtitle.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, bold serif look of the main title.
Provides the clean, geometric, wide-tracked feel for the metadata text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a wide-angle shot of a modern, bright barbershop interior. Include a black and white checkered floor in perspective. Place two vintage brown leather barber chairs in the mid-ground. Populate the scene with a diverse ensemble of 8-10 people in casual red, black, and denim clothing, with one central male figure standing with arms crossed.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large red serif title at the top center. Incorporate a barber pole graphic on the left side of the title. Place a secondary black sans-serif subtitle with wide letter spacing directly underneath the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the floor a clear black and white checkerboard?
Is the central figure the largest and most prominent?
Is the red color consistent between the title and the wardrobe accents?
Is the title text centered and legible against the bright background?

adjustableVariables: Specific wardrobe colors (keeping red as the primary accent)
Intensity of the background shop lighting
Style of the barber chairs (vintage vs. modern)
postGenerationChecks: Check for 10 distinct characters in the ensemble.
Ensure the checkerboard floor follows correct perspective lines.
Verify the red title is the most saturated element in the top third.
Confirm the central figure is perfectly aligned with the vertical center.
recipe.reuseFormula: Ensemble cast + Barbershop setting + Checkerboard floor + Red/Black/White palette + Centered bold serif typography.
